heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service category.

items.question: What mobile app development services do you offer?
items.answer: We build iPhone, Android, Flutter and cross platform apps, as well as AR and VR apps, along with the backend, admin panel, testing, store submission and ongoing support.

items.question: Should I build a native or cross platform app?
items.answer: It depends on your goals, budget and timeline. Native gives the best performance and platform polish, while Flutter and other cross platform options cut cost and time. We explain the trade-offs before development begins.

items.question: How long does it take to build a mobile app?
items.answer: A simple app usually takes 2 to 3 months, while feature-rich apps with custom backends take 4 to 8 months depending on complexity and integrations.

items.question: Will you publish the app on the App Store and Google Play?
items.answer: Yes. We prepare store listings, handle submission and review feedback, and support your launch.

items.question: Do you offer support after the app is launched?
items.answer: Yes. We provide bug fixes, OS compatibility updates, performance monitoring and new feature development.
